name.en: Postnatal check for mother and baby
name.sw: Uchunguzi wa mama na mtoto baada ya kujifungua

what.en: A private-clinic check of the mother (blood pressure, healing, bleeding, mood) and the baby (weight, feeding, jaundice, cord), around week 6.
what.sw: Uchunguzi katika kliniki binafsi wa mama (shinikizo la damu, kupona, kutokwa damu, hali ya moyo) na wa mtoto (uzito, ulishaji, manjano, kitovu), karibu wiki ya 6.

who_provides.en: Private hospital or clinic with a maternity or paediatric service (doctor or nurse-midwife).
who_provides.sw: Hospitali au kliniki binafsi yenye huduma ya uzazi au ya watoto (daktari au muuguzi-mkunga).

free_public_alternative.en: Free at government RCH (reproductive and child health) clinics under the 2007 National Health Policy: postnatal care for the mother and care for children under five. Afya’s own week-6 mood and blood-pressure screen in store is also free.
free_public_alternative.sw: Ni bure katika kliniki za serikali za RCH (afya ya uzazi na mtoto) chini ya Sera ya Taifa ya Afya ya 2007: huduma ya mama baada ya kujifungua na ya watoto chini ya miaka mitano. Uchunguzi wa Afya dukani wa wiki ya 6 (hali ya moyo na shinikizo la damu) pia ni bure.

note: EST (planning, no quote). No Dar private postnatal-check fee was found online. 40,000 reuses the model.js planning figure for a women’s-health clinic consult (Gynaecology check-up, Postnatal physiotherapy, Lactation consultant). Offered as an add-on only: the week-6 check is free at RCH clinics and Afya’s week-6 screen is a store service (code: part3c.js mama svc, w:store).

name.sw: Kupima ukuaji na uzito kila mwezi

what.en: The baby is weighed and measured each month and the reading is added to the growth chart in the app.
what.sw: Mtoto hupimwa uzito na urefu kila mwezi na kipimo huongezwa kwenye chati ya ukuaji kwenye programu.

who_provides.en: Afya Basics store adviser (store service, no partner).
who_provides.sw: Mshauri wa duka la Afya Basics (huduma ya duka, bila mshirika).

free_public_alternative.en: Free monthly growth monitoring at government RCH clinics for children under five (2007 National Health Policy).
free_public_alternative.sw: Ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kila mwezi ni bure katika kliniki za serikali za RCH kwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano (Sera ya Taifa ya Afya ya 2007).

note: Store service: no partner, no service fee (D4: store and public services 0). Its cost sits in the core price. No private walk-in price found or needed. Code already treats it as a store service (part3c.js mama svc, w:store; model.js services.packs mama instore).

name.sw: Kipindi cha kumkanda mtoto

what.en: A short session or small class where a trained practitioner teaches the parent gentle baby massage for bonding and comfort.
what.sw: Kipindi kifupi au darasa dogo ambapo mtaalamu aliyefunzwa humfundisha mzazi kumkanda mtoto taratibu kwa ukaribu na faraja.

who_provides.en: Baby wellness studio, physiotherapist or nurse trained in infant massage.
who_provides.sw: Studio ya afya ya mtoto, mtaalamu wa tiba ya viungo au muuguzi aliyefunzwa kukanda watoto.

note: EST (planning, no quote). No Dar baby-massage provider or price was found online. 25,000 is the model.js walk-in planning figure (mama pack). part3c.js uses the same 25,000 as the partner price, which would put the member at 31,500 (126% of walk-in): see R7 §5.

name.sw: Ziara ya mkunga au muuguzi nyumbani

what.en: A registered midwife or nurse visits the home in the first two weeks: mother’s recovery, baby’s cord, weight and breastfeeding.
what.sw: Mkunga au muuguzi aliyesajiliwa hutembelea nyumbani katika wiki mbili za kwanza: kupona kwa mama, kitovu cha mtoto, uzito na unyonyeshaji.

who_provides.en: Home-care nursing agency or private midwife registered with the Tanzania Nursing and Midwifery Council.
who_provides.sw: Kampuni ya huduma za uuguzi nyumbani au mkunga binafsi aliyesajiliwa na Baraza la Uuguzi na Ukunga Tanzania.

src.name: AfyaDepot (afyadepot.co.tz), Home Nursing Care: Senior Home-care Visit, 50,000 Tsh / unit (comparable, not a midwife quote)

free_public_alternative.en: Government postnatal care is free at RCH clinics (2007 National Health Policy), but it is given at the clinic, not at home.
free_public_alternative.sw: Huduma ya serikali baada ya kujifungua ni bure katika kliniki za RCH (Sera ya Taifa ya Afya ya 2007), lakini hutolewa kliniki, si nyumbani.

note: EST anchored to a Dar comparable. AfyaDepot lists a nurse home visit for older people at 50,000 Tsh (checked 10 Nov 2026); no midwife postnatal-visit price was found. Code planning figure was 40,000 as the partner price (part3c.js), which gives a member price of 50,000 = 100% of the comparable walk-in. This file uses partner price 35,000 (70% of 50,000).

name.sw: Darasa au mazungumzo ya maandalizi ya kujifungua

what.en: A group class or one-to-one check-in on birth preparation, breastfeeding and newborn care. It is not a medical antenatal visit: those belong to the clinic.
what.sw: Darasa la kikundi au mazungumzo ya mmoja kwa mmoja kuhusu maandalizi ya kujifungua, unyonyeshaji na matunzo ya mtoto mchanga. Si ziara ya kitabibu ya kliniki ya wajawazito: hiyo ni ya kliniki.

who_provides.en: Private midwife, maternity hospital education unit or antenatal fitness studio.
who_provides.sw: Mkunga binafsi, kitengo cha elimu cha hospitali ya uzazi au studio ya mazoezi ya wajawazito.

free_public_alternative.en: Medical antenatal visits, iron and folic acid and malaria prevention are free at government RCH clinics (2007 National Health Policy). Afya never charges for them; it only reminds.
free_public_alternative.sw: Ziara za kitabibu za kliniki ya wajawazito, vidonge vya madini ya chuma na foliki na kinga ya malaria ni bure katika kliniki za serikali za RCH (Sera ya Taifa ya Afya ya 2007). Afya haitozi chochote kwa hayo; inakumbusha tu.

note: EST (planning, no quote). No Dar antenatal-class price was found online. 20,000 is the model.js walk-in planning figure (preg pack, Prenatal class). part3c.js lists it as optional and uses 20,000 as the partner price.

name.sw: Ushauri wa ngozi

what.en: A skin check and routine advice with a skin-care professional at a partner clinic: skin type, dark marks, sun protection, and which products to avoid.
what.sw: Uchunguzi wa ngozi na ushauri wa utaratibu na mtaalamu wa ngozi katika kliniki mshirika: aina ya ngozi, madoa meusi, kinga ya jua, na bidhaa za kuepuka.

who_provides.en: Partner skin clinic in Dar es Salaam (no partner signed yet).
who_provides.sw: Kliniki mshirika ya ngozi Dar es Salaam (bado hakuna mshirika aliyesaini).

note: EST (planning, no quote). Walk-in benchmark is AfyaDepot Professional Skin Analysis TSh 40,000 (opened 10 Nov 2026), an aesthetic analysis rather than a doctor consultation. Split follows the postnatal-check pattern. Public alternative not checked.

name.sw: Upimaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa wafanyakazi kila robo mwaka

what.en: A nurse visits the office once a quarter and checks blood pressure for up to 25 staff, with a referral note for anyone with a high reading.
what.sw: Muuguzi anatembelea ofisi mara moja kila robo mwaka na kupima shinikizo la damu kwa wafanyakazi hadi 25, na barua ya rufaa kwa yeyote mwenye kipimo cha juu.

who_provides.en: Partner nursing service (no partner signed yet).
who_provides.sw: Huduma mshirika ya uuguzi (bado hakuna mshirika aliyesaini).

note: EST (planning, no quote). Nearest observed price: AfyaDepot nurse home visit (Minor Wound Dressing) TSh 25,000, opened 10 Nov 2026; × 0.7 partner rate × 1.25 = about 22,000 per visit per 25 staff.

name.sw: Ukaguzi wa sanduku la huduma ya kwanza wakati wa kusafirisha

what.en: The rider checks the first-aid box at each delivery, refills what was used and signs the record.
what.sw: Msafirishaji anakagua sanduku la huduma ya kwanza kila anapofikisha boksi, anajaza kilichotumika na kusaini kumbukumbu.

who_provides.en: Afya store team, included in the membership.
who_provides.sw: Timu ya duka la Afya, imejumuishwa kwenye uanachama.

note: Store service, included.

name.en: Staff blood-pressure check at the store
name.sw: Upimaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa wafanyakazi dukani

what.en: Every employee on the account can have blood pressure checked in the store each month.
what.sw: Kila mfanyakazi kwenye akaunti anaweza kupimwa shinikizo la damu dukani kila mwezi.

who_provides.en: Afya store team, included in the membership.
who_provides.sw: Timu ya duka la Afya, imejumuishwa kwenye uanachama.

note: Store service, included.

name.sw: Ukaguzi wa klorini kwenye maji ya kunywa

what.en: The store adviser tests a sample of the household’s treated water for free chlorine and shows the right dose.
what.sw: Mshauri wa duka anapima sampuli ya maji ya kaya yaliyotibiwa kuona klorini na kuonyesha kipimo sahihi.

who_provides.en: Afya store team, included in the membership.
who_provides.sw: Timu ya duka la Afya, imejumuishwa kwenye uanachama.

note: Store service, included.

name.sw: Upimaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa familia

what.en: Any adult in the household can have blood pressure and weight checked in the store each month.
what.sw: Mtu mzima yeyote katika kaya anaweza kupimwa shinikizo la damu na uzito dukani kila mwezi.

who_provides.en: Afya store team, included in the membership.
who_provides.sw: Timu ya duka la Afya, imejumuishwa kwenye uanachama.

note: Store service, included.

name.sw: Nafasi ya mafunzo ya huduma ya kwanza yaliyoidhinishwa

what.en: One staff member trained and certified as the workplace first-aider (two a year for a hotel).
what.sw: Mfanyakazi mmoja anafunzwa na kuthibitishwa kuwa mhudumu wa huduma ya kwanza kazini (wawili kwa mwaka kwa hoteli).

who_provides.en: Licensed partner company (no partner signed yet).
who_provides.sw: Kampuni mshirika yenye leseni (bado hakuna mshirika aliyesaini).

note: EST. Planning figure from the financial model, no partner quote. Business accounts 30,000 walk-in; the hotel add-on uses 50,000.

name.sw: Huduma na kujaza upya kizima moto

what.en: Once a year a fire-safety company checks and refills the extinguisher.
what.sw: Mara moja kwa mwaka kampuni ya usalama wa moto inakagua na kujaza upya kizima moto.

who_provides.en: Licensed partner company (no partner signed yet).
who_provides.sw: Kampuni mshirika yenye leseni (bado hakuna mshirika aliyesaini).

note: EST. Planning figure from the financial model, no partner quote.

name.sw: Ziara ya kudhibiti wadudu

what.en: A licensed pest-control company treats the kitchen (restaurants, twice a year) or rooms and kitchen (hotels, quarterly).
what.sw: Kampuni yenye leseni ya kudhibiti wadudu inatibu jiko (migahawa, mara mbili kwa mwaka) au vyumba na jiko (hoteli, kila robo mwaka).

who_provides.en: Licensed partner company (no partner signed yet).
who_provides.sw: Kampuni mshirika yenye leseni (bado hakuna mshirika aliyesaini).

note: EST. Planning figure from the financial model, no partner quote. Restaurants 60,000 walk-in; hotels 80,000.

name.sw: Ziara ya kudhibiti wadudu nyumbani (nyongeza)

what.en: A licensed pest-control company treats the home for cockroaches and rodents.
what.sw: Kampuni yenye leseni ya kudhibiti wadudu inatibu nyumba dhidi ya mende na panya.

who_provides.en: Licensed partner company (no partner signed yet).
who_provides.sw: Kampuni mshirika yenye leseni (bado hakuna mshirika aliyesaini).

note: EST. Planning figure from the financial model, no partner quote.
Store service, included.

name.sw: Ukaguzi wa ukuaji

what.en: Height, weight, BMI and blood pressure at the Afya Check in store, free; the reading goes on a chart in the app.
what.sw: Urefu, uzito, BMI na shinikizo la damu kwenye Afya Check dukani, bure; kipimo huwekwa kwenye chati kwenye programu.

who_provides.en: Afya store team, included in the membership.
who_provides.sw: Timu ya duka la Afya, imejumuishwa kwenye uanachama.

note: Store service, included.

name.sw: Kikumbusho cha dawa za minyoo

what.en: A reminder before the June and December holidays to check the school deworming round, free.
what.sw: Kikumbusho kabla ya likizo za Juni na Desemba kukagua awamu ya dawa za minyoo shuleni, bure.

who_provides.en: Afya store team, included in the membership.
who_provides.sw: Timu ya duka la Afya, imejumuishwa kwenye uanachama.

note: Store service, included.

name.sw: Kikumbusho cha chanjo ya HPV

what.en: A reminder of the free single-dose HPV vaccine from the public programme, for girls at 9 or who missed it.
what.sw: Kikumbusho cha chanjo ya bure ya HPV ya dozi moja kutoka mpango wa serikali, kwa wasichana wa miaka 9 au walioikosa.

who_provides.en: Afya store team, included in the membership.
who_provides.sw: Timu ya duka la Afya, imejumuishwa kwenye uanachama.

note: Store service, included.

name.sw: Mazungumzo ya hedhi ya kwanza

what.en: A private talk in store with a female adviser, with a parent if she wishes, at the first box, free.
what.sw: Mazungumzo ya faragha dukani na mshauri mwanamke, pamoja na mzazi akipenda, katika sanduku la kwanza, bure.

who_provides.en: Afya store team, included in the membership.
who_provides.sw: Timu ya duka la Afya, imejumuishwa kwenye uanachama.

note: Store service, included.

name.sw: Mazungumzo ya kubalehe

what.en: A private talk in store with a male adviser at about 12 and 15, free.
what.sw: Mazungumzo ya faragha dukani na mshauri mwanaume akiwa na takriban miaka 12 na 15, bure.

who_provides.en: Afya store team, included in the membership.
who_provides.sw: Timu ya duka la Afya, imejumuishwa kwenye uanachama.

note: No partner quote yet; price published once quoted.

name.sw: Uchunguzi wa meno (nyongeza)

what.en: A six-monthly check-up with a partner dentist, booked as an add-on.
what.sw: Uchunguzi wa meno kila miezi sita kwa daktari wa meno mshirika, unaoagizwa kama nyongeza.

who_provides.en: Partner dental clinic (no partner signed yet).
who_provides.sw: Kliniki mshirika ya meno (bado hakuna mshirika aliyesaini).
